baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَرْسَلْنَا ... رِجَالًا نُّوحِىٓ إِلَيْهِم مِّنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْقُرَىٰٓ / يَسِيرُوا۟ ... فَيَنظُرُوا۟ ... عَٰقِبَةُ / تَعْقِلُونَ
baseline_models.mechanism: Concealed communication enters ordinary civic history through embodied local messengers; later hearers are sent across the same earth to inspect the consequences that history leaves behind. Reason closes the circuit by binding transmitted report to observed outcome.

activation_trace.role: The messenger-and-message branch supplies the relay by which a carried saying enters public history.
The human-man branch keeps the carriers on the audience's ordinary bodily and social scale.
The hidden imparting of knowledge supplies the initially concealed source of the public claim.
Belonging to a near group embeds the recipients of revelation among actual residents rather than outside history.
People gathered in a settlement make the town a civic site where message, response, and consequence accumulate.
Going and flowing turn geography into an evidential procedure rather than scenery.
Directed sight or insight converts travel into deliberate apprehension.
The ending and what an act bequeaths identify the object that the traveler must inspect.
Understanding that restrains ignorance supplies the final inference from trace to consequence.

changed_reading.before: The ayah merely states that earlier prophets were human and asks people to remember punished predecessors.
changed_reading.after: The ayah constructs an evidence circuit: hidden revelation becomes civic history through human carriers, then later bodies test its truth by moving, looking, and reasoning from outcomes.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: مِن قَبْلِكَ / ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ / عَٰقِبَةُ / دَارُ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ خَيْرٌ / ٱتَّقَوْا۟ / تَعْقِلُونَ
baseline_models.mechanism: The doubled 'before' folds two prior horizons around the present audience; outcome then opens onto the later abode. The better horizon is available to those who place a protective interval between themselves and harm, so reasoning is temporally disciplined choice rather than bare cognition.

activation_trace.role: Temporal precedence supplies the two receding horizons whose sequences must be compared with the present.
Succession and replacement make each present state intelligible through what follows it.
Residence in a dwelling gives the later horizon the force of an inhabited condition, not a passing episode.
Laterness after the first extends evaluation beyond the immediately visible phase.
Choosing or seeking the better turns the temporal contrast into a live evaluative decision.
A protective barrier supplies the practical posture by which delayed harm is taken seriously now.
Restraining ignorance makes reason the faculty that refuses to judge a sequence before its outcome.

changed_reading.before: The afterlife clause is a conventional reward appended to a warning about old peoples.
changed_reading.after: The later abode is the controlling horizon of the historical comparison: reason delays judgment, compares whole sequences, and chooses present protection by the final rather than immediate state.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence moves from a scent that others dismiss as old error, through returned sight, to a prior dream reaching its realized truth. This revises 'look at the outcome': an outcome does not merely add an object to vision; it can reverse the observer's earlier classification and make an initially hidden sign legible.

activation_trace.role: Directed sight anchors the changed model in the focus command to apprehend rather than merely encounter.
The realized ending supplies the point from which an earlier judgment can be reassessed.
Scent and smelling supply a real but nonvisual signal that precedes public confirmation.
Being judged astray supplies the confident misclassification that the later outcome overturns.
Return to a prior state makes restored sight a concrete reversal rather than gradual persuasion.
Eyesight restored supplies the visible hinge between rejected signal and acknowledged knowledge.
A sign returning to its eventual outcome makes fulfillment a retrospective disclosure of meaning.
One event following another keeps that disclosure grounded in an ordered sequence rather than a free gloss.
Stable correspondence with reality supplies the criterion by which the earlier vision is vindicated.

structural_cues: 12:94-96 orders scent, accusation of old error, arrival, returned sight, and the claim 'I know ... what you do not know.'
12:100 names the dream's realization while explicitly contrasting 'before' and 'after' in the completed life sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a nonvisual clue, its dismissal, restored sight, and a dream made true; I infer that realized outcome recalibrates the seer as well as revealing an object. A live alternative is that this is only a family-recognition sequence and does not generalize the travel command.

changed_reading.before: Travel lets an already competent observer inspect external remains.
changed_reading.after: Seeing an outcome can expose the observer's own prior blindness: the end reorganizes earlier signs and reverses what had been confidently called error.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately after reunion, elevation, and fulfilled vision, granted sovereignty is named but not treated as the terminal good. The prayer crosses from the near world to the later one, from possession to being taken whole in surrender and joined to the sound community. This makes the better abode a revaluation of success at its climax, not compensation for failure.

activation_trace.role: Residence supplies the focus contrast between a present station and the enduring later habitation.
The phase after the first provides the horizon beyond restored worldly rank.
Superior worth and selection make final affiliation outrank possession without denying the latter's goodness.
Sovereignty supplies the highest worldly achievement against which the later good is measured.
Near protective alliance relocates security from owned power to enduring relation.
The near or lower world supplies the explicitly limited side of the temporal comparison.
Taking the soul supplies the crossing by which a successful worldly life is still not its own completion.
Surrendering and releasing the self define the requested terminal posture in contrast to mastery.
The later one catching and reaching those ahead makes final success an arrival into company.
Soundness opposed to corruption identifies the company whose condition defines the desired end.

structural_cues: 12:100 has already supplied throne, reunited family, benevolence, release from prison, and fulfilled vision before the prayer of 12:101.
12:101 places 'the near world and the later world' in one invocation and then moves directly to death and affiliation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies achieved sovereignty followed by a prayer for surrender and righteous company; I infer that the sequence ranks final belonging above even legitimate worldly culmination. A live alternative is that the prayer expresses gratitude without functioning as a critique of worldly success.

changed_reading.before: The later abode is better chiefly for people deprived or defeated here.
changed_reading.after: The later abode relativizes even fulfilled vision, family restoration, and sovereignty; its superiority is clearest at the worldly climax, where possession yields to surrender and final company.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same earth is crowded with visible signs, yet people pass directly over them while turning their flank. Sudden arrival finds them without fine awareness, whereas the announced path is walked on inward sight and trace-following. The focus sequence therefore contrasts locomotion with attentive travel: movement can preserve blindness unless looking interrupts it.

activation_trace.role: Going across the earth anchors the model in actual motion.
Directed sight supplies the missing operation that distinguishes inquiry from transit.
Restraint from ignorance turns noticed signs into a checked conclusion rather than a fleeting impression.
An outwardly apparent mark establishes that the evidential field is already exposed.
Passing and crossing supply motion that reaches the sign but does not retain it.
Turning one's side supplies the attentional refusal operating inside physical proximity.
Suddenness supplies the consequence of assuming that repeated passage guarantees warning time.
Fine awareness names the perceptual granularity absent when the sudden event arrives.
A traversable extended path makes the call a sustained way rather than a single glance.
Heart-sight supplies the inward discrimination required alongside outward exposure.
Tracing effect after effect converts the path into disciplined attention to sequence.

structural_cues: 12:105 and 12:109 both place the observer in the earth, but the former says they pass over signs while turning away and the latter joins travel to looking.
12:107 adds arrival without perception; 12:108 immediately defines the path by بصيرة before 12:109 asks for travel, sight, and reason.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies visible signs, passers, aversion, unperceived surprise, and a path on insight; I infer that 12:109 repairs the failed motion of 12:105 by inserting deliberate looking. A live alternative is that the two movements are only adjacent examples of heedlessness and inquiry, not an intentional contrast.

changed_reading.before: Travel itself exposes enough evidence to produce understanding.
changed_reading.after: Proximity and motion can reproduce heedlessness; the decisive command is to stop bypassing, direct sight, follow traces, and let reason hold the sequence together.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah holds the sequence open until hope is cut off and the truth-status of the messengers is under pressure; only then does help arrive, separate the rescued, and leave overpowering force irreversible. The focus 'outcome' is therefore a delayed bifurcation, not only the ruins of rejecters, and a snapshot at despair is specifically premature.

activation_trace.role: What comes before supplies the incomplete phase that must not be mistaken for the whole sequence.
The final result anchors the model in evaluation after the sequence closes.
Deferral to a later time extends the warning against judging from the threshold moment.
Hope cut off supplies the apparent endpoint that the ensuing arrival reverses.
The same messenger line named in the focus carries the delayed pattern into the immediate sequel.
An affair whose outcome cannot yet be trusted supplies the unstable judgment at the threshold.
Attribution of lying makes messenger credibility part of what the arrival will decide.
Aid that makes manifest supplies the positive reversal after apparent closure.
Rescue by separation supplies one side of the bifurcated outcome.
Overpowering severity supplies the other side, which cannot be redirected once the sequence closes.

structural_cues: The boundary word حَتَّىٰ holds 12:110 open through despair and disputed credibility before the arrival of help.
One arrival yields both rescue for selected persons and force that cannot be turned from the criminal people.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an until-threshold, severed hope, unstable credibility, arriving aid, separation, and irreversible force; I infer that 12:109 asks readers to judge only the completed arc. A live alternative is that 12:110 specifies the messengers' cycle without widening the sense of the prior peoples' outcome.

changed_reading.before: The outcome of earlier peoples means a single punitive endpoint visible in their remains.
changed_reading.after: The outcome is a delayed fork: vindication and rescue emerge only after the sequence looks closed, while judgment becomes irreversible on the other branch.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final ayah defines story as following an ordered trace and lesson as crossing from one case into another. Confirmation and detail preserve the sequence while mercy gives its destination. Narrative can thus perform a portable analogue of the focus journey: the reader follows footprints through the account, crosses from their case to the present, and sees the end without collapsing literal travel.

activation_trace.role: A traversed course or manner of proceeding anchors narrative reading in the focus's path-shaped demand.
Footprint and what lies behind make the outcome recoverable by following a trace.
Discriminating restraint supplies the inferential transfer from narrated case to present hearer.
Following an أثر turns story into ordered tracking rather than detachable anecdote.
Passing from one side to another supplies the reader's movement through the narrated sequence.
Making one condition a lesson for another supplies the analogical crossing into the hearer's present.
Fulfilled word and deed make the traced story evidential confirmation rather than invented diversion.
Detail that distinguishes parts and meanings preserves the steps required for causal reading.
Tender mercy makes the traced warning also a route offered for repair.

structural_cues: 12:111 calls the completed قصص an عبرة for 'possessors of cores,' directly echoing the focus question about reasoning.
The denial of invented report and the sequence confirmation, detail, guidance, and mercy specify how the account should be traversed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies trace-following story, cross-case lesson, confirmation, detail, and a reason-bearing audience; I infer that narrated sequence can function as an analogical journey through outcomes. A live alternative is that 12:111 only states the story's value while 12:109 retains an exclusively physical travel demand.

changed_reading.before: Only geographic travel grants access to the evidence of earlier outcomes.
changed_reading.after: The surah itself offers a second, nonexclusive mode of travel: follow its ordered footprints, cross analogically into the prior case, and reason from the disclosed end.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the camel-hobbling branch of ع ق ل rather than the ordinary lexical sense of understanding. It remains anchored in تَعْقِلُونَ and is activated by the contrast between travel, pass-by, and looking; downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for cognitive restraint, never as a replacement translation.

activation_trace.role: Hobbling a camel supplies a physical image for checking onward motion so that passage can become examination.
Going supplies the motion that requires cognitive restraint rather than automatic continuation.
Passing by supplies the failed form of motion that reaches evidence without stopping for it.
Turning the flank shows why interruption, not further distance, is the needed correction.

changed_reading.before: Reason is generic mental assent after evidence is encountered.
changed_reading.after: As an exploratory material image, reason hobbles unchecked passage long enough for encountered evidence to become a seen and integrated outcome.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the pedestrian branch of ر ج ل is activated beneath the surface noun 'men.' It remains anchored by the explicit travel command, earth, and path; downstream prose should call it a secondary embodied resonance, not claim that رِجَالًا lexically means pedestrians here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: رِجَالًا نُّوحِىٓ إِلَيْهِم / يَسِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ

activation_trace.role: Walking on feet gives the human messengers an exploratory terrestrial resonance shared with the commanded travelers.
Hidden imparting places transcendent information within those ordinary moving bodies.
Travel assigns the audience the same earthbound mode through which historical evidence is reached.
The ground beneath the sky supplies the shared material field of messenger and examiner.
A path extended for walking joins embodied carriage of the call to embodied verification of its history.

changed_reading.before: Calling the messengers men only denies that they were nonhuman.
changed_reading.after: As a contained resonance, the messengers and their hearers share feet, towns, paths, and ground: revelation is carried and tested within one terrestrial human scale.

strongest_changes: Outcome became epistemic reversal: fulfillment can correct the observer who had misclassified an earlier sign.
Travel split into mere pass-by and attentive trace-following; movement alone can preserve blindness.
The later abode revalued worldly success at its climax, while 12:110 made outcome a delayed fork of rescue and irreversible judgment.
The completed story became a portable analogue of travel through its linked images of tracking, crossing, confirmation, and detail.
summary.what_was_special: The context activated several coexisting mechanisms rather than one theme: sensory rehabilitation, temporal revaluation, attentional interruption, threshold reversal, and narrative traversal. The pedestrian ر ج ل and hobbling ع ق ل branches added contained bodily images that a conservative reading would likely lose.
remaining_uncertainties: The sensory reversal in 12:94-100 may illuminate only the family sequence rather than redefine the general travel command.
The agent and force of the disputed lying in 12:110 remain grammatically live, although either reading still places credibility under pressure before aid arrives.
The pedestrian and hobbling activations are branch-backed resonances, but their distance from the surface senses requires explicit qualification.
Narrative travel in 12:111 should supplement, not erase, the literal geographic demand of 12:109.
